title: Pure Scrap
summary: Scrap cards only, with generic staples; the page's Dinosaur and Orcust hybrids are left out. Scraps destroy each other on purpose: each one that a Scrap card destroys searches, revives or summons the next. Scrap Raptor destroys one of your monsters for an extra Scrap Normal Summon and searches Scrap Factory or a non-Tuner when it is destroyed itself. Scrap Factory and Scrap Wyvern summon a fresh Scrap from the Deck each time, and Scrap Golem revives the small ones for the Level 8 and 9 Synchros. The newest Scrap-named cards, Scrap Synchron and Scrap Warrior, are Junk Warrior support, and the page explains why they break the Scrap loop, so they stay out. The 2025 Trap Scrap Garage revives DARK Machines, which this deck does not have, so it stays out too.
main: Tuner starter: destroys your monster for an extra Scrap Normal Summon; searches Factory or a non-Tuner.
Normal Summoned: revives a Scrap Tuner from the GY.
Tuner: destroyed by a Scrap card, returns a Scrap from the GY to the hand.
Tuner: summons itself next to a Scrap and destroys one; recovers a Scrap when destroyed.
Sends a Machine from the Deck to the GY when summoned; recycles them for a draw.

Tuner: destroyed by a Scrap card, returns a Scrap from the GY to the hand.
